tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background (warm paper). Also the browser theme-color and the fill of a checked RadioRow/CheckboxRow.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, inputs, selects, choice rows, the AuthShell aside, landing pillars.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper (16.6:1) and surface (17.8:1). Fill of the primary button, the checked chip and the 'ink' badge; completed progress steps.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, card descriptions, hints, eyebrows. 6.9:1 on paper, 7.4:1 on surface, 6.2:1 on secondary.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text only: placeholders, '(optional)', footer legal copy. 4.9:1 on paper, 5.3:1 on surface — never on brand-soft or tinted grounds.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decorative, not a control boundary).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: secondary-button border, choice-row and chip borders, dashed EmptyState border. Note: 1.7:1 on surface, below the 3:1 non-text minimum for control borders — flagged, kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: input-border
tokens.usage: Text input and select borders: 3.4:1 on surface, 3.2:1 on paper (meets 3:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one bronze accent: focus ring, current progress step, wordmark dot, 'brand' badge text, 'Icon' status tier. 5.7:1 on paper — usable as text. Never a large fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind brand text (badge), text selection highlight. brand on brand-soft is 5.1:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and the met-requirement check. 5.5:1 on success-soft; white on success 6.4:1.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success alerts and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text (e.g. GST review notes). 5.7:1 on warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning alerts and badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors: field errors, invalid input border, destructive button fill (white text 6.9:1). 5.6:1 on danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for danger alerts and badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text ('Coming in the next build'). 7.4:1 on info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for info alerts and badges.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: secondary fill. Same value as accent.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: muted fill — Skeleton placeholders.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: hover fill for secondary and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: shadcn alias of paper — body background.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn alias of ink — body text.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: shadcn alias of surface — Card fill.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn alias of ink — text on cards.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: shadcn alias of surface — popovers (none built yet).

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn alias of ink.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: primary button fill is ink, not the brand bronze.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: text on primary (16.6:1).

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: CardDescription text.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: destructive button fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: default border colour on every element.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: input borders.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: 2px focus outline, offset 2px; also an input's focused border.

families.serif: "Newsreader Variable", ui-serif, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: DisplayHeading — one per page at most (landing hero). 2.25rem below the sm breakpoint.

styles.name: page-heading
styles.usage: PageHeading — the h1 of every app, auth and onboarding page. 1.875rem below sm.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The Wordmark text, followed by a brand dot.

styles.name: serif-title
styles.usage: Editorial tile titles: landing pillars, consent document titles. Access tiles use 1.125rem.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A fuller profile helps us match you with the right programmes.
styles.usage: Lede under a PageHeading, in ink-muted, max-width 65ch. Landing lede steps up to 1.125rem.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your progress is saved after every step.

styles.name: body-ui
styles.usage: Input/select values and choice-row labels (500 weight on labels).

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Connecting an account verifies your creator activity.
styles.usage: Descriptions, hints, alerts, field errors, card descriptions.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrow and MetricBlock labels — uppercase, ink-muted.

styles.name: legal
styles.sample: CreatorCo is not a bank or lender.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tailwind base unit (0.25rem). Badge vertical padding is 2px (py-0.5).

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Badge icon gap, progress-step gap, checklist rows, CardHeader gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The most used gap: label→control, chip lists, inline groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Choice-row inner gap and vertical padding, button groups, fieldset items.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Input and select horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Choice-row horizontal padding, list-row padding, alert padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, dashboard grid gap, button md padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (CardHeader/CardContent).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter (sm+), form→back-link spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Heading block → step content; landing CTAs.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Dashboard section spacing; AuthShell aside padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: PageShell main top/bottom padding (sm+).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Landing hero → pillars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: calc(--radius − 4px). Small inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, alerts, choice rows, list groups, EmptyState.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The base --radius (0.5rem): Cards and the landing pillar grid.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: calc(--radius + 4px). Reserved; not used yet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, progress tracks, status dots.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Button sm height (header actions).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Button md, Input and Select height — the default touch target.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Button lg height (page-level CTAs).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Every shell header (h-16).

tokens.name: width-app
tokens.usage: PageShell and landing max width (max-w-6xl).

tokens.name: width-onboarding
tokens.usage: OnboardingShell single column (max-w-2xl).

tokens.name: width-form
tokens.usage: AuthShell form column (max-w-md).

tokens.name: width-prose
tokens.usage: Lede measure (max-w-prose).

tokens.usage: Disabled / aria-disabled buttons.

tokens.usage: Disabled inputs, selects, labels and choice rows.
